activation_memory_note: inference working arrays only; excludes features, supervisor, firmware, radio/RTC, stacks and logging

formulas.occupancy: lane-mean E1 point occupancy fraction; EMA time constant 5 s
formulas.rates: unique passage pulses in previous 10 s, divided by 10 and served-approach motor lane count; capped at 2 veh/s/served lane
formulas.receiving_exit_occupancy: maximum EMA across downstream rows reachable by the stage; no movement intentions supplied
formulas.time_since_green: (time - last stage green start)/300, capped at 2
formulas.elapsed_green_ratio_or_clearance_flag: elapsed current green / reference green, capped at 2; -1 during clearance
formulas.counted_region_stock: max(0, boundary inflow cumulative - boundary outflow cumulative)/documented stock scale; capped at 3; absolute estimate only valid with known initial inventory
formulas.region_net_flow: (last-10s boundary inflow rate - boundary outflow rate)/5, clipped [-2,2]
formulas.observer_trusted: 1 for complete modeled boundary, known initialization, ideal-count assumption, no historical negative raw balance and fresh heartbeats; otherwise 0. Configured count noise sets trust to 0.

counter_equation: N(t)=N0+sum(all boundary entry pulses)-sum(all boundary exit pulses). Upstream 5/30/60 observations are overlapping evidence, not three independent inflows.
counter_scope: total vehicles stored in the selected closed region, including moving vehicles; not per-approach queue length
initialization: N0=0 is valid for these empty-start simulations only. Real startup requires independently established N0; do not silently initialize an occupied road to zero.
side_access: extra side-boundary rows in catalog.json are required to close the region. Missing side flows are unknown, not zero.
identity_backend: simulation IDs deduplicate ideal row passage events internally; no IDs, route intentions, speeds or exact queues are policy inputs. Real pulse generation/crosstalk/motorcycle resolution must be tested.

actions.0: keep current green until next decision or supervisor boundary
actions.1: request next cyclic green via 4 s yellow and 4 s all-red; accepted only after minimum green

supervisor.scope: motor-only pilot; no pedestrian/emergency demand implemented; timings are simulation assumptions, not field-approved

policy_data_boundary: Only point occupancy, pulse counters and controller state enter inference. SUMO halting/pending/arrival truth is used for rewards and audit only.
outage_inventory_rule: A required puck stale for >3 s invalidates absolute N0 reconciliation for that site. Heartbeat recovery never rezeros or repairs lost counts. Raw balance remains logged; absolute-stock feature is withheld pending independent reconciliation.
passage_semantics: A passage at the upstream nominal-5m row is near-stopline evidence, not confirmed intersection discharge. Confirmed departures are counted by the post-intersection rows. Actual shifted locations are in catalog.json.
